# tools: github: support extension list

Manage GitHub CLI extensions declaratively. **Motivation:** `gh` is extended by `gh extension install <repo>` (the example, [actions/gh-actions-cache](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/caching-dependencies-to-speed-up-workflows#force-deleting-cache-entries), deletes Actions caches); the author wants the list restored on a new machine and upgraded by `self-update`, the way Brewfiles and `tools.go` do for packages.

Current list:

```bash
$ gh extension install actions/gh-actions-cache
```
